SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-05-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline
FROM orders.orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND (
    (order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04')
    OR (order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-05-28')
  );
